# Rosalind Penrose

## Overview

- **Age:** forty-five  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Origin:** Welby  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosalind is a small woman who never seems to age, keeping a bright, youthful complexion, dimples, rosy cheeks, sweet lips, and a voice like white satin. She has thick, wavy, snow-white hair set in flattering puffs and coils, and large, gentle, wood-brown eyes filled with tiny flecks of gold. She wears delicate clothes such as cream muslin patterned with light roses or gowns of forget-me-not organdy.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c28 P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v3 c23 P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## Personality

Rosalind is charming, imaginative, and deeply fond of playful pretending despite her age. Although she withdrew from social life into an isolated stone cottage and ignored societal rules—such as flouting conventional dietary guidelines—she is warm-hearted and hospitable to her friends. She possesses a lighthearted vanity regarding beautiful gowns and admits to feeling embarrassed by how much a new dress thrills her.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 c28 P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019), [v3 c23 P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## Traits

- imaginative and fond of pretending  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>

## History

Rosalind grew up in Welby and was named by her father after the lavender that kept him awake thinking of her mother. In her youth, she was considered a major beauty and was betrothed to Stephen Stanhope, but after a quarrel twenty-five years prior, the engagement ended and he departed for the United States. Following her mother's death, she remained at Echo Cottage—an ancient stone house—and hired a series of young Bowman girls as helpers, calling each one 'Belinda'. She withdrew from broader social life, leading many to forget her, though she formed a close, warm friendship with Nell Harcourt. Upon Stephen Stanhope's return, the two reconciled, walked together, and were married in an informal ceremony in her honeysuckle arbor. After their wedding, she traveled to the Pacific coast and settled into a new home, later returning to Echo Cottage for summer stays.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)_
